events.title: Wicker
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 23 | An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

events.title: Wildwood
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 23 | After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel launches a desperate rescue mission into an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Ore, inhabited by bandits, talking animals and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. From Laika Studios (Coraline, Kubo and the Two Strings).

events.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
events.description: OPENS THURSDAY, OCTOBER 29 | A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

events.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 30 | When a theft goes awry, a veteran pickpocket is sent on a mission through New York to reclaim it.
